newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Resolute says lifts Ghan gold resources.
newsitem.headline: Resolute says lifts Ghan gold resources.

text.p: Resolute Samantha Ltd said on Wednesday it was confident the resource base at its Obotan gold project in Ghana is in the order of 2.0 million ounces.

"Potential for futher increases in reserves/resources remains excellent given that all three known deposits at Nkran, African Star and Adubiaso are yet to be fully defined," Resolute said in a statement.
The Obotan resource was previously estimated at 1.4 million ounces, a company spokesman said.
The Perth-based miner also announced it had poured its first gold at the project, 215 km northwest of the Ghanian capital Accra.
Obotan is forecast to produce an initial 126,000 ounces of gold a year.
However, Resolute said it was undertaking a feasibility study to evaluate a staged increase in throughput capacity from 1.4 million tonnes of ore a year to 2.0 million tonnes.
This equated to an extra 20,000 to 30,000 ounces a year.
Resolute said it had agreed to acquire an extra 7.5 percent in the project from Obotan Minerals, a private company, for US$500,000 plus 1.25 million Resolute shares.
The deal means Resolute would hold 90 percent of the project and the Ghanian government would hold the rest.
